row.proto: void Ui_HbBuffer_MergeClusters(void *buffer, uint32_t start, uint32_t end)
row.notes: cxx=hb_buffer_t::merge_clusters_impl (HarfBuzz). If cluster_level (+0x1c) == 2 it only marks glyphs in [start,end) whose cluster differs from the range minimum as unsafe (mask byte |= 3, scratch_flags +0xb4 |= 0x20). Otherwise finds the minimum cluster (info +0x68, stride 0x14, cluster +8), extends the range over equal clusters on both sides (len +0x58, idx +0x54, out_len +0x5c, out_info +0x70) and writes the minimum cluster to all, clearing the low 3 mask bits when it changes.
